hebrewText: ו/צפן יִצְפֹּ֣ן לַ֭/יְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְ/הֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם

tokens.bdb: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
tokens.kjv: esteem, hide(-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret(-ly, place).

tokens.bdb: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
tokens.kjv: esteem, hide(-den one, self), lay up, lurk (be set) privily, (keep) secret(-ly, place).
convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est), [phrase] pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness).

tokens.bdb: support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding
tokens.kjv: enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working.

tokens.bdb: a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile
tokens.kjv: [idiom] armed, buckler, defence, ruler, [phrase] scale, shield.

tokens.bdb: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (all) along, apace, behave (self), come, (on) continually, be conversant, depart, [phrase] be eased, enter, exercise (self), [phrase] follow, forth, forward, get, go (about, abroad, along, away, forward, on, out, up and down), [phrase] greater, grow, be wont to haunt, lead, march, [idiom] more and more, move (self), needs, on, pass (away), be at the point, quite, run (along), [phrase] send, speedily, spread, still, surely, [phrase] tale-bearer, [phrase] travel(-ler), walk (abroad, on, to and fro, up and down, to places), wander, wax, (way-) faring man, [idiom] be weak, whirl.
